text:
alex_sales: Hey team — Freelancer Foundry (startup accelerator partner) asked for a one-off promotional package for a 6-week POC. They want $10k in credits + a 20% discounted per-token rate for production if they convert. Asking for approval from deal desk; I flagged as high risk because org ARR likely low but channel value could be high. details: expected peak traffic ~300k tokens/week, mostly embeddings + short chat prompts.

tara_se: Sounds like standard presales ask. Will need support during POC (integration + eval prompts). Can we offer a pared-down plan: $5k credits + white-glove onboarding (2 sessions) + 10% rate for 3 months? That reduces cost exposure.

sam_dealdesk: What revenue commit or conversion signal are we asking for? Deal desk won't sign off on pure free credits without some expectation (email intro, case study, or minimum commit).

alex_sales: They said they may convert to a paid acc if POC shows perf. No firm commit. Partner is pushing for stronger promo to drive adoption across their cohort.

liam_csm: If we do credits, we should require a short success plan: milestones at week 2/4/6 and a signed opt-in to a 3-month follow-on discounted plan (no monetary commit, just opt-in). We can prioritize them in onboarding if they agree.

sam_dealdesk: OK proposal from deal desk: option A: $5k credits + 12% discounted token rate for 3 months + mandatory success plan + partner co-marketing mention. Option B (exception): $10k credits + 20% discount but requires a 6-month minimum committed spend at our published discounted rate (we'd need legal ok). Which do you want to pursue?

tara_se: From SE side, Option A is safe and still compelling. Option B has legal + finance exposure. Also, if they're embedding-heavy, cost could spike. We should include a cap under either option (e.g., credits only applied up to 600k tokens/week).

security-bot: FYI — they filled part of the security questionnaire but need clarification on data residency and whether PII will be stored. For private PII we'd recommend Private deployment or clear data retention TOs. Need to include SOC2 + KMS notes in the offer.

alex_sales: Good catch. The partner said they might pass PII through the prompts. We can't give $10k free without a secure binding. OK, I'm leaning to Option A with a weekly token cap and co-marketing ask.

sam_dealdesk: If you want Option A, I can approve in deal desk today. Need two things from you: (1) a 1-paragraph justification for the credits (channel value + expected conversions), (2) a proposed promo code or billing tag so finance can track.

alex_sales: Heading to a meeting in 10m. I'll drop the justification here after. Proposed promo tag: FF_ACCEL_Q2_26.

liam_csm: I'll volunteer to lead the success plan template. If you send the justification I'll attach the milestones and success KPIs.

alex_sales: Justification: Freelancer Foundry runs a 12-week accelerator; this cohort includes ~30 early-stage startups who will trial our API. If 3–5 convert to paid with typical starter commits (~$2k/mo) that's ~6–10k ARR and several reference customers for the channel. Partner asked for stronger incentive to prioritize our stack vs competitor X. We will require the partner to co-market a joint webinar and agree to customer reference interviews.

sam_dealdesk: Good. Approving Option A with the following formal conditions: $5,000 credit applied to account over 6 weeks, 12% discount applied for 3 months post-POC, promo tag FF_ACCEL_Q2_26, weekly token cap 600k, signed success plan and co-marketing agreement. I'll route to finance to create the billing tag and label.

security-bot: Addendum: include clause about no storage of PII unless customer signs Data Processing Addendum and chooses Private deployment or explicitly agrees to retention settings.

tara_se: I'll prep a quick onboarding checklist and a short runbook for the cohort — integration snippets, prompt templates, and cost-control tips (batched embeddings, prefix caching).

alex_sales: Awesome, thanks everyone. Sam — ping me if finance needs any more paper. :thumbsup:

sam_dealdesk: Will do. Marking thread resolved for approvals, will post the formal terms after finance confirms billing tag. :white_check_mark:

liam_csm: Assigning myself to Outreach/Success once the cohort list is live.

alex_sales: Thanks — follow-ups scheduled.
